entities.subtitle: Walmart observations and following a rideshare vehicle
entities.description: Selected car-to-car radio traffic from September 12, 2026, about suspected theft at Walmart, following a rideshare vehicle, and reviewing store footage. The later discussion about what officers believed the footage showed is included. Some overlapping observations about other people and vehicles remain for context.
